title: Quantum Signatures of Two-Electron HBT Interference in Free Space
summary: Understanding how fermionic exchange and Coulomb repulsion jointly shape two-electron correlations is essential for identifying genuine quantum signatures in multi-electron interference experiments. To address this interplay, we investigate Hanbury Brown and Twiss interference of two electrons generated by two independent needle-tip emitters within a full quantum-mechanical framework. In the absence of Coulomb interaction, the approach reproduces the results previously obtained within a quantum path formalism.
